sql: select (select max(started_at) from incentive_discovery_cycles) last_discovery, (select liquidity_programs from incentive_discovery_cycles order by id desc limit 1) liq_programs, count(distinct s.market_ticker) mkts_15m, count(distinct s.market_ticker) filter (where s.market_ticker not ilike '%MENTION%' and s.market_ticker not ilike 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH%') non_universe_mkts_15m, count(*) snaps_15m, (select max(received_at) from incentive_trade_events) last_trade from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
